matchups.recap: Rob got absolutely robbed by a single fucking point—which tracks perfectly for a season where he's been getting mugged by his own roster decisions. That 93.7 point performance is what you get when your "strategy" is apparently hoping your bench outscores your starters by sheer accident. Adam's 94.7 wasn't exactly a masterclass in fantasy management either, but hey, a win's a win when you're beating a guy who somehow made his team worse than a bye week.

Rilind just got absolutely skull-fucked by his own blood, losing by nearly 20 points to Rinor this week. That's the kind of ass-kicking that gets brought up at every single family dinner for the next year—Thanksgiving, Christmas, random Sundays, all of it. Rinor's gonna be milking this victory until next season starts, and honestly, Rilind deserves it for putting together a roster so pathetic it couldn't beat a team managed by someone who has to see him at family functions. Better luck next week, little bro—or whatever the family pecking order is now.

Jetmir and Peter got absolutely cock-blocked by 5 points—so close they could taste it, but not quite enough to swallow the W. That's what happens when you ride a team all season and it decides to take a collective shit in Week Whatever-The-Fuck-This-Is. Flamur's still breathing down your neck like a creditor, and you two are out here playing fantasy with a participation trophy mindset. Better luck next week, boys—you're gonna need it.

Ilir got absolutely dicked down by 9.3 points this week—and not even by the good kind of team, just by Arben's mid-tier roster shuffling. This is what happens when you spend all season convincing yourself your RB2 is "due for regression" while your bench rots on the waiver wire like day-old sushi. Better luck next week, chief—you'll probably need it.

Nori got absolutely cock-blocked by 5.4 fucking points this week, which is basically fantasy football's way of telling you that your team management is a steaming pile of dogshit. You couldn't score a touchdown's worth of points more than your opponent—that's not a loss, that's a fucking cry for help. Maybe next time don't roster players that have all the production value of a high school bench warmer. Faton's laughing his ass to the bank while you're over there wondering why your studs performed like practice squad extras.

Veton got absolutely skull-fucked by a 24-point margin this week—Ben didn't just beat you, he lapped you twice and tea-bagged your corpse on the way by. You managed to put up 74 points in a PPR league and still lose by nearly a full game's worth; that's not a loss, that's a goddamn crime scene. Next time maybe actually field a lineup instead of whatever Frankenstein bullshit you cobbled together from your bench, because this wasn't competitive, it was an execution.

matchups.preview: Rinor's stumbling into this matchup barely treading water at 1-1, but hey, at least he can say he's won a game—something Rob's apparently forgotten how to do. Rob's 0-2 start is looking less like bad luck and more like a masterclass in draft incompetence, so Rinor should be able to sleepwalk through this one unless he decides to bench his studs for waiver wire garbage again.

Adam's already half-dead at 1-1 and now he's about to get absolutely dismantled by a 2-0 team that actually knows what the fuck they're doing—Flamur's out here running circles around this league while Adam's out here wondering why his "late-round sleeper" strategy keeps blowing up in his face. This is the matchup where Adam finds out the hard way that being .500 against the best team in the league means getting sent back to 1-2 and sulking about his draft picks for another week.

Rilind's sitting at 1-1 trying to convince himself he's still in this, but Arben's cruising at 2-0 and about to send him back to the drawing board where he belongs. This is the matchup where Rilind's "I'll turn it around next week" excuse gets exposed for the bullshit it is, because Arben's offense is rolling and Rilind's roster is held together with duct tape and delusion.

Jetmir and Peter rolling in at 1-1 looking like they've got their shit together, but we all remember that Week 2 collapse—one of you drafted like you were playing checkers while everyone else played 4D chess. Nori's sitting right there at 1-1 too, but at least he's got the excuse of being new to this level of incompetence. This week one of these teams remembers why they're frauds, and honestly, it could go either way because they're all equally capable of spectacular failure.

Ilir's sitting at 1-1 with a roster that screams "I panic-drafted at 2 AM," while Ben's clinging to .500 like it's a life raft made of tissue paper—this week one of you finally gets exposed as the fraud you've been all season, and honestly, it could go either way since you're both running on fumes and wishful thinking.

Faton's crawling out of the basement at 1-1, which basically makes him the league's garbage disposal—he'll take whatever scraps are left and somehow still manage to fuck it up. Meanwhile Veton's sitting at 0-2 looking like he's never seen a waiver wire before, so this should be a thrilling matchup between two teams that have no business being competitive, but hey, one of you clowns is going home with a W this week.
